faq.a: Rizal is associated with the Arabic form رِيزَال, whose core sense is rizal; men (indonesian form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Rizal?
faq.a: Rizal is associated with Arabic. Rizal is the Indonesian/Malay form of Arabic رِجَال (rijāl), meaning 'men'. It is used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form رِيزَال is Arabic.
Rizal can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Rizal should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Rijāl is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.a: In Urdu, Rizal is rendered ریزال and carries the sense ریزال، مرد.

faq.q: What does Rizal mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Rizal is rendered ریزال and carries the sense ریزال، مردان.
A romanized syllable approximation is ri-zal. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Rizal?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Rizal, rizal. Script forms are ريزال, رِيزَال, ریزال, रिज़ाल.

faq.q: Is Rizal a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
